system_prompt: You are an expert DevOps engineer. Generate production-quality Infrastructure as Code (IaC) in response to the user's natural-language request. Output ONLY the IaC code (no explanation, no markdown fences) in the language explicitly specified by the user. Apply best practices appropriate to a real production deployment, including security defaults.
original_prompt: Create a CloudFormation template that provisions an AWS KMS customer-managed key with key rotation enabled, for encrypting database backups.
user_message_sent:
Target IaC language: AWS CloudFormation (YAML)

Task: Create a CloudFormation template that provisions an AWS KMS customer-managed key with key rotation enabled, for encrypting database backups.

Output only the AWS CloudFormation (YAML) code, no commentary or markdown fences.
raw_response:
AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: KMS CMK for encrypting database backups with key rotation enabled

Parameters:
  KeyAliasName:
    Type: String
    Default: alias/db-backups
    AllowedPattern: '^alias\/[a-zA-Z0-9/_-]{1,255}$'
    Description: KMS alias name to create for this key (must start with alias/)
  Environment:
    Type: String
    Default: prod
    AllowedValues:
      - prod
      - staging
      - dev
      - test
  Project:
    Type: String
    Default: database
  PendingWindowInDays:
    Type: Number
    Default: 30
    MinValue: 7
    MaxValue: 30
    Description: Waiting period for key deletion scheduling

Resources:
  KmsKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      Description: Customer managed KMS key for encrypting database backups
      EnableKeyRotation: true
      KeySpec: SYMMETRIC_DEFAULT
      KeyUsage: ENCRYPT_DECRYPT
      PendingWindowInDays: !Ref PendingWindowInDays
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: EnableIAMUserPermissions
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root
            Action: 'kms:*'
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: AllowRDSServiceUseForBackups
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: rds.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - kms:Encrypt
              - kms:Decrypt
              - kms:ReEncrypt*
              - kms:GenerateDataKey*
              - kms:CreateGrant
              - kms:DescribeKey
            Resource: '*'
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                kms:ViaService: !Sub rds.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com
                kms:CallerAccount: !Ref AWS::AccountId
          - Sid: AllowAWSBackupServiceUse
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: backup.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - kms:Encrypt
              - kms:Decrypt
              - kms:ReEncrypt*
              - kms:GenerateDataKey*
              - kms:CreateGrant
              - kms:DescribeKey
            Resource: '*'
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                kms:ViaService: !Sub backup.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com
                kms:CallerAccount: !Ref AWS::AccountId
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Ref KeyAliasName
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref Project

  KmsKeyAlias:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Alias
    Properties:
      AliasName: !Ref KeyAliasName
      TargetKeyId: !Ref KmsKey

Outputs:
  KeyId:
    Description: KMS KeyId
    Value: !Ref KmsKey
    Export:
      Name: !Sub ${AWS::StackName}-KeyId
  KeyArn:
    Description: ARN of the KMS Key
    Value: !GetAtt KmsKey.Arn
    Export:
      Name: !Sub ${AWS::StackName}-KeyArn
  AliasName:
    Description: Alias name for the KMS key
    Value: !Ref KeyAliasName
  AliasArn:
    Description: ARN of the KMS key alias
    Value: !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:kms:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:${KeyAliasName}
